evidence: Independently read current source.md and all spec.md including the final verification-binding amendment, PRODUCT-INTENT.md, prior Astra intent-review.json/md, operations.goal_digest/derive and work.task_digest/check_state/derive. The current implementation previously bound acceptance only to goal/version/revision/task IDs, so a changed artifact or same-version task criterion could be rerun and make stale acceptance accepted again. The amended required acceptance.verification_sha256 and verification_digest bind project ID, current revision, current criteria and the raw management artifact/plans/test_plans/attempts/blockers/work six-key input. Binding all project verification inputs is conservative and covers dependency/task-definition/proof replacements including same-time changes. Implementers must digest ORIGINAL management input fields, not time-derived management status/verification fields; this preserves the explicit exclusion of generated_at, state, reasons, hooks and capture. Goal digest remains separately required. No model implementation or acceptance success is certified by this receipt. Source four requirements and prior Astra boundaries remain intact: person-to-session-to-goal and evidence; measured north stars separated from declared contributions and independent personal goals; owner-only atomic local capture health with degraded/unknown failures and actual-app coverage pending; durable opt-in authenticated incremental central transmission and same-origin UI with real remote two-environment proof pending. Existing actor/source admission, unmapped native hook retention, conservative lifecycle/measurement/time rules, explicit unsupported deletion, Codex response JSON and user-owned hook trust remain unchanged. This is a new independent review by the kit agent, not an Astra review, and the earlier Astra receipt remains historical. No private logs, global hook/trust changes, external destinations or operational deployment are approved by this review. Final source reread confirms explicit projected-original normalization: remove only derived test-plan criterion_signature/test_plan_sha256, attempt status and blocker verification; preserve all other original keys so ordinary time-derived status changes do not invalidate acceptance. Compared management.derive source: it adds attempt status and blocker verification while no current test-plan additions exist. The normalization addresses the independently identified projection issue; broad project verification input intentionally requires conservative reconfirmation after unrelated verification changes.
